title: 第27章 我要当兵王，请往死里虐我
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “准备开饭！”“调整凳子！”“坐！”一套口令下来，新兵们这才落座。早饭，都是各班小值日提前来食堂打好的，来了就吃。早餐内容很丰盛，鸡蛋，牛奶，花卷，包子应有尽有。尤其是炊事班自已腌的香辣萝卜干，还有爽脆泡菜，格外爽口下饭。班上有个饿坏的新兵，没忍住先一步拿了个包子，刚要放进嘴里一道冷冷的眼神就扫了过来。这个兵立马心虚的挤出微笑，将包子递到班长碗里：“班长，您先吃。”部队的规矩，通常都是班长第一个动快，因为班长是所有新兵的大家长。但周凯东却并没有吃，而是将这个包子给了陆阳，语重心长的说。“陆阳，昨天团领导着重表扬了，你画的黑板报，夸你很有想法。”“另外着重强调说，你的身体素质体能有待加强，要给你加强锻炼。”此话一出，三班新兵眼睛全部瞪大。先前，他们刚被不指名道姓的批评了一顿，陆阳这就把场子又找回来了？好像每回三班整体挨罚挨骂，班副总能用一已之力，帮着挽回一丝颜面。尤其，这次还是在团部领导那里挂了号，被着重点名栽培，这可比被指导员关注厉害太多。等于一下子跳了两级，直接跨越营级，和团领导搭讪了关系！陆阳也是没料到，那副黑板报还引起团副正委的关注。到目前为止，他遇到过级别最高的也就只是高峰和何镇涛这样的上尉军官。现在被副团级的校官点名，重点关注，他还是有点儿受宠若惊的。而先前正在发呆的丁腾飞，再一次成为反面教材，内心像是生吞了几十个柠檬。他不明白为什么明明是自已跑了第一，陆阳只是倒数。最后却是自已挨骂挨罚，他被各种关注和表扬？明明自已已经力争上游，已经在很努力的积极表现！周凯东看着陆阳，严肃的说：“今后，我会用更加严格的标准要求你，争取在下连之前让你有质的飞跃，你最好有个心理准备。”陆阳自信一笑：“班长，我励志要当兵王，请你往死里虐我，谢谢。”周凯东被逗笑了：“这么嚣张？别回头，十圈跑碎兵王梦，再跟我说你是读书人。”大伙儿逗笑了，没想到私底下的班长还是挺有梗的，顺口溜一套一套的。随后，周凯东又看向孔垄：“还有你。”孔垄兴奋极了：“咋地班长，我也被领导点名表扬啦？”“那倒没有。”“哦。”“你那蛋白粉别喝了，米饭馒头也给我少吃点，跟特么猪一样，全连没见谁比你饭量大。”“十天内，给我把那身笨重肌肉给我减了，你训练成绩还能拔高一截。”“啊？”孔垄脸都快垮到桌上。连忙说自已臂围已经整整小了一大圈，再减就没了。这身腱子肉他下了很大苦功夫才练出来的，实在舍不得丢掉。周凯东可不听他的解释：“让你减就减，哪特么儿那么多废话？”孔垄很是憋屈：“那我带来的那么些蛋白粉，怎么办？”周凯东：“要么喂猪，要么给陆阳喝，你自已选。”陆阳一口稀饭差点喷出来：不是，怎么我还和猪画等号了？不过，班长话糙理不糙，他现在正需要那些东西。部队伙食虽然好，但架不住都是年轻大小伙子，都在长身体。一帮十八九岁每天跑步训练的青年人，饭量多大不言而喻。而强化训练，需要额外的营养来源补充，否则身体根本吃不消。所以对于底子薄弱的陆阳而言，孔垄的那些蛋白粉和营养补剂，就是最好的补充。但他绝对不会占兄弟便宜，直言那些补剂多少钱，回头他原价购入，绝对不让孔垄吃亏。孔垄摆摆手：“还要啥钱啊，都是兄弟，你吃了总比猪吃了强，猪肯定没你吃的明白。”陆阳眼睛瞪得像铜铃：“你礼貌吗，就问你礼貌吗？”大家都在使劲憋着笑，班长先前说的要么喂猪，要么喂陆阳，实在太有梗了。简单的几句插科打诨，就将先前食堂门口挨骂的负能量瞬间冲淡。部队里，不是只有严肃；活泼，也是必要的调味品。这时，周凯东的目光也终于落到了丁腾飞身上。而丁腾飞眼里也立马点儿期待，他期待着班长说点什么。哪怕是在先前那番话后头加一句：蛋白粉喂猪，喂陆阳，甚至是喂丁腾飞也不给你！可看着丁腾飞这张脸，周凯东使劲憋了半天，也不知道该说点儿啥？该批评的话，先前连长已经批评过了，再讲一遍也没意义。况且，他也不想再打击这小子的自尊心，只能不痛不痒的说了句。“吃饭别开小差，就你吃的最慢，不许浪费！”“是...”丁腾飞无奈垂下头，失落的扒拉餐盘里的饭菜，却如同嚼蜡，食之无味。……中午吃完饭，回到宿舍。孔垄打开柜子，从里头拿出一包包分装好的蛋白粉。极为郑重，又不舍的交到陆阳手里，全然一副生离死别的模样。看到他这肉疼的表情，陆阳不由得想到当初在火车上，这个大傻子用胶带纸将白色粉末包装袋，缠满全场的作死名场面。陆阳尴尬开口：“咳咳，不至于吧？”孔垄当即比了个“力拔山兮”的标准姿势，接着就是一个“恶魔之角”，还有“思想者”。他的眉宇之间散发着哲觉气息，如同被黄金比例分割后的章鱼哥：“你知不知道，锤炼一身肌肉得花多少功夫？要用多少时间？要吃多少顿水煮鸡胸肉，西兰花，蛋白？”“原本，我的梦想是冲击奥赛，结果......！”“奥数比赛？”忽然，班里有人插科打诨的问了一句。“孔垄，你这脑瓜子，还能参加奥数比赛？”“不是数学的那个奥数，是奥林匹亚先生健美大赛，世界男子健美运动最高水平的比赛！”“所以，是干嘛的？”“比谁肌肉练得好看，练得完美，像施瓦辛格那样！”“然后呢？”“没有然后了。”“切~~”原以为会和铁人三项，马拉松似的，没想到就是比谁练得更好看而已？难怪班长总说孔垄这身是死肌肉，必须得脱掉。挠个后背，胳膊都伸不过来，这玩意儿除了瞧着唬人一点不实用。陆阳前世也看过类似健美比赛视频，但印象最深的那是那句：那我问你，那我问你，你脑袋怎么尖尖的？但因为不是圈内人，所以他也总看不明白，不知道一帮人喷的黑不溜秋，站在台上比划啥？听完孔垄的解释，他才明白过来，原来健身的终极目标就是选美。但，练成那样，像是剥皮牛蛙似的，真的好看吗？据说还有许多科技大佬，背后皮肤整的跟癞蛤蟆似的，三四十岁就英年早逝了。陆阳摸着下巴，一脸沉思：“那我是不是得控制着点儿剂量？每次喝多少啊，我怕练成你这样。”孔垄眼睛瞪的像铜铃，瞬间跟炸了毛似的：“你以为练成这样很容易吗，你知道我吃了多少苦，受了多少罪，尤其是备赛期......”“算了，说多了你也听不懂，反正就正常喝就行了。”“行。”“这个是氮泵，还有肌酸，训练累了喝一口，能快速补充体力......”陆阳从来没喝过这玩意儿，瞧着跟奶茶似的，闻着更像。于是他提溜着暖水瓶，准备打点儿热水，回来先泡上一杯尝尝咸淡。其他人也多没喝过这玩意儿，一个个跟凑热闹似的，也想弄点儿尝尝。这会儿，水房里正有其他班新兵在打热水，天气越来越冷热水消耗的也比较快，于是陆阳就在门口稍微等了一会儿。却没成想前头那家伙竟一次把热水打光了，重新烧还得等好一会儿！就在陆阳死守着饮水机，等着它从绿灯跳到红灯时，肩膀忽然被人从后头拍了一下。“能不能......谈谈？”
content_en: "Get ready to eat!" "Adjust the stools!" "Sit down!" After a set of commands, the recruits took their seats.Breakfast is prepared in the canteen in advance for each class on duty and is eaten as soon as they arrive.The breakfast is very rich, including eggs, milk, rolls, and steamed buns.Especially the spicy dried radish pickled by the cooking team and the crispy kimchi, which are particularly refreshing with rice.There was a hungry recruit in the class who couldn't help but take a bun first. Just as he was about to put it in his mouth, he glanced over with a cold look.The soldier immediately smiled guiltily and handed the buns to the squad leader's bowl: "Squad leader, you eat first." According to the rules of the army, the squad leader is usually the first to act quickly, because the squad leader is the parent of all recruits.But Zhou Kaidong didn't eat it. Instead, he gave the bun to Lu Yang and said sincerely."Lu Yang, the regiment leader emphatically praised you yesterday for the blackboard poster you drew, praising you for your great ideas." "In addition, he emphasized that your physical fitness needs to be improved, and you should be given more training." As soon as these words came out, the eyes of all the recruits in the third class widened.They had just been criticized by someone who didn't name them, and now Lu Yang brought the situation back?It seems that every time the third class is punished and scolded as a whole, the class vice president can always do his best to help save a little face.Especially, this time I got registered with the regiment leader and was focused on being cultivated. This is much more powerful than being paid attention to by the instructor.It's like jumping two levels at once, directly crossing the battalion level, and striking up a relationship with the regiment leader!Lu Yang also didn't expect that the blackboard report would attract the attention of the vice-chairman of the regiment.So far, the highest-ranking officers he has encountered are only captain officers like Gao Feng and He Zhentao.Now that he was called out by a deputy regimental-level school officer and given special attention, he was still a little flattered.Ding Tengfei, who was in a daze before, once again became a negative example, feeling as if he had swallowed dozens of lemons alive.He didn't understand why Lu Yang was just counting down when he was the first.In the end, he was scolded and punished, and he received all kinds of attention and praise?It is obvious that he has strived to reach the top and is already working hard and performing actively!Zhou Kaidong looked at Lu Yang and said seriously: "From now on, I will use stricter standards to ask you to make a qualitative leap before you go to the next company. You'd better be mentally prepared." Lu Yang smiled confidently: "Squad leader, I am determined to be the king of soldiers, please.Torture me to death, thank you." Zhou Kaidong was amused: "You are so arrogant, don't look back, run around to destroy the soldier Wang Meng, and then tell me that you are a scholar." Everyone was amused, but they didn't expect that the squad leader was quite funny in private.Then, Zhou Kaidong looked at Kong Long again: "And you." Kong Long was very excited: "What the hell, squad leader, have I been named and praised by the leader?" "That's not true." "Oh." "Don't drink your protein powder, and give me the rice and steamed buns too.I'll eat less.I'm like a pig.I don't think anyone in the company eats more than you." "If you lose those bulky muscles in ten days, your training results will be even better." "Huh?" Kong Rong's face almost dropped to the table.He quickly said that his arm circumference had already shrunk by a large margin, and it would disappear if it decreased further.He had put in a lot of hard work to develop this tendon, and he really couldn't bear to throw it away.Zhou Kaidong didn't listen to his explanation: "You can reduce it if you want. Why is there so much nonsense?" Kong Long was very aggrieved: "Then what should I do with all the protein powder I brought?" Zhou Kaidong: "Either feed the pigs, or give it to Lu Yang to drink, you make your own choice." Lu Yang almost spat out his porridge: No, why am I still equated with a pig?However, the squad leader's words were rough, and he needed those things now.Although the food in the army is good, it can't be tolerated because they are all young men and women, and they are all growing in shape.It goes without saying that a group of young people aged 18 or 19 who run and train every day have a huge appetite.Intensive training requires additional nutritional sources, otherwise the body will simply not be able to bear it.Therefore, for Lu Yang, who has a weak foundation, the protein powder and nutritional supplements from Konglong are the best supplements.But he would never take advantage of his brother. He bluntly stated how much those supplements cost. He would buy them back at the original price and would never let Kong Long suffer a loss.Kong Long waved his hand: "What more money do you need? We are all brothers. It is better for you to eat than for pigs to eat. Pigs will definitely not understand what you eat." Lu Yang's eyes widened like copper bells: "Are you polite? I just ask you if you are polite?" Everyone was trying their best to hold back their laughter. What the squad leader said before about either feeding pigs or Lu Yang was really ridiculous.A few simple jokes instantly diluted the negative energy of being scolded at the cafeteria door.In the army, seriousness is not all there is; liveliness is also a necessary condiment.At this time, Zhou Kaidong's eyes finally fell on Ding Tengfei.Ding Tengfei also immediately looked forward to it. He was looking forward to what the squad leader would say.Even if I add a sentence after the previous words: Feed protein powder to pigs, feed Lu Yang, or even feed Ding Tengfei, I won’t give it to you!But looking at Ding Tengfei's face, Zhou Kaidong held it in for a long time and didn't know what to say.If criticism is needed, the company commander has already criticized it before, so there is no point in saying it again.Besides, he didn't want to hurt this kid's self-esteem anymore, so he could only say it calmly."Don't skip the meal, you eat the slowest, don't waste it!" "Yes..." Ding Tengfei lowered his head helplessly, plucking the food on the plate in frustration, but it was like chewing wax and tasteless....After lunch, we returned to the dormitory.Kong Long opened the cabinet and took out packages of packaged protein powder.It was handed over to Lu Yang's hands with great solemnity and reluctance, as if it was a matter of life and death.Seeing his pained expression, Lu Yang couldn't help but think of the famous scene on the train where this idiot packed the white powder bag with tape and wrapped it around the whole place.Lu Yang said awkwardly: "Ahem, that's not the case, is it?" Kong Long immediately made a standard gesture of "stretching up the mountain", followed by a "devil's horn" and a "thinker".There was a philosophical atmosphere between his brows, like Squidward divided by the golden ratio: "Do you know how much effort it takes to build a body of muscles? How much time does it take? How many meals of boiled chicken breast, broccoli, and egg whites do you need to eat?" "Originally, my dream was to compete in the Olympiad, but...!" "Math Olympiad?" Suddenly, someone in the class asked a joke."Kong Long, you are such an idiot, can you still participate in the Mathematical Olympiad?" "The Mathematical Olympiad is not mathematics, it is the Mr. Olympia Bodybuilding Competition, the highest level competition in men's bodybuilding in the world!" "So, what is it for?" "Comparing with who has beautiful and perfect muscles, like Schwarzenegger!" "Then what?" "No more." "Tsk~~" I thought it would be like a triathlon or a marathon, but I didn't expect it was just to compete with who can look better?No wonder the squad leader always said that Kong Long's body was full of dead muscles and had to be taken off.When you scratch your back, you can't even stretch your arms out. This thing is useless except for looking at and bluffing people.Lu Yang had also seen similar bodybuilding competition videos in his previous life, but the sentence that impressed him most was: Then let me ask you, then let me ask you, why is your head so pointy?But because he is not an insider, he can't always understand it. He doesn't know what a group of people are saying when they are standing on the stage and gesticulating.After listening to Kong Long's explanation, he realized that the ultimate goal of fitness was beauty pageants.But, does it really look good when you look like a skinned bullfrog?It is said that there are many technology tycoons whose skin on their backs looks like toads, and they died young in their thirties or forties.Lu Yang touched his chin and looked thoughtful: "Then do I have to control the dosage? How much should I drink each time? I'm afraid I will become like you." Kong Long's eyes widened like bells, and his hair suddenly felt like it was exploding: "Do you think it is easy to become like this? Do you know how much hardship I have suffered and how much I have suffered, especially when I was preparing for this?During the competition..." "Forget it, you won't understand if I talk too much, just drink it normally." "Okay." "This is a nitrogen pump, and it also has creatine.Take a sip when you are tired from training, and it can quickly replenish your energy..." Lu Yang has never drank this stuff. It looks like milk tea and smells more like it.So he carried the thermos bottle, preparing to get some hot water. When he came back, he would make a cup to taste the saltiness.Most of the others had never drunk this stuff before, and they all seemed to be joining in the fun and wanted to try some.At this moment, there were other recruits in the water room fetching hot water. The weather was getting colder and hot water was running out faster, so Lu Yang waited at the door for a while.But I didn't expect that the guy in front of me actually used up all the hot water at once, and it would take a long time to heat it up again!Just as Lu Yang was guarding the water dispenser, waiting for it to jump from the green light to the red light, someone suddenly tapped him on the shoulder from behind."Can we... talk?"
